description: Specify thermal clump or pebble group names. Use of the group logic is described in Groups. By default, s is assigned to the group slot Default. Use the add keyword to assign the group name to the next available slot and the remove keyword to remove s from all slots. The optional pebble keyword can be given before the optional range to specify that the group name will be applied to thermal pebbles. In this case, the range is applied to thermal pebbles and not to thermal clumps.

keywords.name: add
keywords.description: Assign s to the next available slot.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Set group slot slot to s. By default, slot Default is used.

keywords.name: pebble
keywords.description: Apply the group name to thermal pebbles; the range then applies to thermal pebbles and not to thermal clumps.

examples.description: Assign the group in the Default slot
Assign the group in a named slot

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): clump.thermal.isgroup reads True after assignment to the Default and a named slot, and False again after remove, on all six consoles.
